overview.title: Overview
overview.body: CheapestGo acts as an intermediary between you and travel suppliers (hotels, airlines, and package providers). Cancellation and refund rights are primarily governed by the individual supplier's policies, which vary by property, rate type, and booking dates. This policy explains how we facilitate cancellations and refunds on your behalf.

cancellationTypes.title: Hotel Cancellation Types
cancellationTypes.intro: When you book a hotel through CheapestGo, you will see one of the following rate types:

free.heading: Free Cancellation
free.body: You may cancel at no charge before the deadline specified at booking. The exact deadline (e.g., "Free cancellation until 48 hours before check-in") is shown on the booking page and in your confirmation email.

partial.heading: Partially Refundable
partial.body: A partial refund applies depending on when you cancel relative to the check-in date. The penalty amount and cutoff dates are displayed before you confirm payment.

nonRefundable.heading: Non-Refundable
nonRefundable.body: No refund is provided if you cancel. These rates are typically lower in price and are clearly labeled "Non-refundable" before checkout.

howToCancel.title: How to Cancel a Booking
steps: Log in to your CheapestGo account and go to My Bookings.
Select the booking you wish to cancel and click Cancel Booking.
Review the cancellation policy and any applicable fees shown on screen.
Confirm the cancellation. You will receive a cancellation confirmation email.
howToCancel.emailAfter: with your booking reference number and we will process the cancellation within 1 business day.

items.label: Eligible refunds
items.text: are processed back to the original payment method (credit/debit card or GrabPay) used at checkout via Stripe.

items.label: Processing time
items.text: Once we initiate the refund, it typically takes 5–10 business days to appear on your statement, depending on your bank or card issuer.

items.label: CheapestGo service fee
items.text: Any applicable platform service fees are non-refundable unless the cancellation is due to a supplier error or CheapestGo system fault.

items.label: Stripe processing fees
items.text: Payment processing fees charged by Stripe are non-refundable by CheapestGo, in line with Stripe's standard policy.

items.label: Currency
items.text: Refunds are issued in the same currency as the original payment. Exchange rate differences at the time of refund are not our responsibility.

noShows.title: No-Shows
noShows.body: If you fail to check in on the scheduled arrival date without cancelling in advance, the booking will be treated as a no-show. No-show policies vary by hotel — most hotels will charge the full booking amount. CheapestGo cannot override hotel no-show policies. We strongly recommend cancelling ahead of time if your plans change.

amendments.title: Booking Amendments
amendments.intro: Date changes, room type changes, and guest name corrections are subject to hotel availability and supplier policies. To request an amendment:
steps: Contact us at support@cheapestgo.com with your booking reference
Specify the change you need and the reason
We will check availability with the supplier and confirm if the amendment is possible
amendments.noteText: Amendments may result in a price difference (additional charge or credit) and may not always be possible without cancelling and rebooking. We cannot guarantee that amendment requests will be accommodated.

supplierCancellations.title: Supplier Cancellations and Force Majeure
supplierCancellations.intro: In rare cases, a hotel or travel supplier may cancel your booking due to overbooking, closure, natural disaster, or force majeure events. If this occurs:
items: CheapestGo will notify you as soon as we are informed by the supplier
We will process a full refund of the amount paid to CheapestGo, including our service fee
We will assist you in finding alternative accommodation where possible, though we cannot guarantee a replacement
supplierCancellations.note: CheapestGo is not liable for losses arising from supplier cancellations, including transportation costs, additional hotel nights booked elsewhere, or consequential losses. We recommend purchasing travel insurance to cover such events.

disputes.title: Disputes and Chargebacks
disputes.body: If you have a concern about a charge, please contact us at support@cheapestgo.com before initiating a chargeback with your bank. Most issues can be resolved quickly. Chargebacks initiated without first contacting CheapestGo may result in account suspension. CheapestGo reserves the right to contest chargebacks that are made in bad faith or that do not comply with our cancellation policy.

flightPackages.title: Flight Packages
flightPackages.body: For all-inclusive flight + hotel packages, cancellation terms depend on both the hotel and airline components. Airline tickets are generally non-refundable or carry significant cancellation fees. The specific terms for your package will be shown during checkout and in your confirmation email. If you need to cancel a package, contact us immediately at support@cheapestgo.com for guidance.

contact.title: Contact for Refund Requests
contact.intro: For all refund and cancellation queries, please have your booking reference number ready and reach us at:
contact.address: 🏢 FORHU Inc. · 30 Wall Street, 8th Floor · New York, NY 10005 · USA
contact.outro: We aim to respond to all refund requests within 1–2 business days.

whatAreCookies.title: What Are Cookies?
whatAreCookies.body: Cookies are small text files placed on your device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work efficiently, to remember your preferences, and to provide information to website operators. Similar technologies include web beacons, pixels, local storage, and session storage, all of which we refer to collectively as "cookies" in this policy.

whyWeUse.title: Why We Use Cookies
items: Keep you signed in and maintain your session securely
Remember your preferences (currency, language, dark/light mode)
Save your recent searches and viewed properties
Prevent fraud and protect the security of your account
Measure performance and understand how visitors use our platform
Personalize content and show relevant deals and recommendations

categories.heading: Strictly Necessary Cookies
categories.body: These cookies are essential for the Platform to function. They enable core features such as authentication, session management, security tokens, and payment processing. You cannot opt out of these cookies as they are required for the service to operate.
items: supabase-auth-token — authentication session
__stripe_mid / __stripe_sid — Stripe fraud prevention

categories.heading: Functional Cookies
categories.body: These cookies remember your choices and personalize your experience. Disabling them may reduce functionality.
items: Currency preference (e.g., KRW, USD, PHP)
Theme preference (dark or light mode)
Recently viewed hotels and search history

categories.heading: Analytics Cookies
categories.body: These help us understand how visitors interact with the Platform — which pages are most visited, where users drop off, and how we can improve the experience. Data is aggregated and anonymized where possible.
items: Page view tracking and session duration
Click-through rates on deals and search results
Error logging and performance monitoring

categories.heading: Marketing Cookies
categories.body: We may use these to show you relevant travel deals on our Platform. We do not currently serve third-party advertising. If this changes, we will update this policy and request your consent.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Cookies
thirdParty.intro: Some cookies are set by third-party services that appear on our pages:
thirdParty.stripeBefore: sets cookies for fraud detection and payment session management. See
thirdParty.supabaseText: sets authentication cookies to manage your login session on our database infrastructure.
thirdParty.outro: We have no control over third-party cookies. Please review the respective privacy policies of these providers for more information.

items.label: Session cookies
items.text: deleted automatically when you close your browser. Used for login sessions and temporary state.

items.label: Persistent cookies
items.text: remain on your device for a set period (typically 30 days to 1 year). Used for preferences and analytics.

managing.title: Managing Your Cookie Preferences
managing.intro: You can control cookies in several ways:

items.label: Browser settings
items.text: Most browsers allow you to refuse or delete cookies via their settings (usually under Privacy or Security). Note that disabling strictly necessary cookies will break core functionality such as login and checkout.

items.label: Cookie banner
items.text: When you first visit CheapestGo, you may be presented with a cookie consent banner where you can accept or decline non-essential cookies.

items.label: Opt-out tools
items.text: For analytics, you can use browser extensions such as the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on where applicable.

managing.note: Adjusting your cookie settings may affect the functionality of the Platform. Essential cookies cannot be disabled without impacting your ability to use CheapestGo.

doNotTrack.title: Do Not Track
doNotTrack.body: Some browsers send a "Do Not Track" (DNT) signal. CheapestGo does not currently respond to DNT signals, as there is no universal standard for how websites should react to them. We continue to evaluate this area as standards evolve.

changes.title: Changes to This Cookie Policy
changes.body: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in technology, regulation, or our use of cookies. When we make material changes, we will update the "Last Updated" date at the top of this page. Continued use of the Platform after changes are posted constitutes your acceptance of the revised policy.

about.heroTitle: Travel that respects your time and your wallet.
about.heroBody: CheapestGo is a modern travel platform that helps you discover, compare, and book flights and hotels in one place — at prices you can actually trust.
about.missionBody: Booking travel should feel effortless, not adversarial. Too many platforms bury fees, inflate prices, and make you second-guess every click. We built CheapestGo to do the opposite: surface the best real prices, show exactly what you pay, and get you booked in as few steps as possible — whether you are chasing a weekend escape or planning the trip of a lifetime.
about.flightsBody: Search and book flights worldwide through our airline partners, with clear pricing and no surprise fees at checkout.
about.hotelsBody: Millions of hotels and unique stays, sourced from leading global suppliers so you always have real availability and rates.
about.dealsBody: Curated weekend getaways and travel deals, updated daily, so the best value is the first thing you see.
about.transparentBody: We apply a single, transparent service markup that is already included in the price you see. No hidden fees, ever.
about.secureBody: Payments are processed by Stripe and we never store your card details. Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest.
about.builtBody: We focus on travelers in Southeast Asia — local currencies, local context, and support that understands how you travel.
about.partnersBody: Our flight, hotel, and payment inventory comes from established global providers, so the availability and rates you see are real and bookable.
about.whoBody: CheapestGo is operated by FORHU Inc., headquartered at 30 Wall Street, 8th Floor, New York, NY 10005, United States. Questions, feedback, or partnership ideas are always welcome.
